start: Signed in as the owner; internet on; member page of a member with a part-paid running membership

steps.action: In the Memberships card tap "Cancel" on the plan
user_sees: "<plan> (<first day> → <last day>) will no longer count, and its unpaid amount is removed from their dues. It stays on their page, and you can undo this later."
Box "Reason" (example "Moved city") with "Saved with the membership, so it is clear months later."
must_not: The membership cancelled by the first tap with no question

steps.action: Type a reason of three letters or more, tap "Cancel membership"
must_not: Money already received removed from income

user_sees: The row shows "<amount> unpaid · not in dues" and button "Undo cancel"
Dues tile no longer counts this plan
must_not: The row gone from the page
The member still chased for the cancelled amount

start: Signed in as the owner; "Cancel this membership?" sheet open

steps.action: Type two letters as the reason
must_not: A cancel saved with no reason

user_sees: Sheet closes; the membership is as before

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the row
user_sees: "Cancel" is greyed and says it needs internet
must_not: A cancel kept only on this device

steps.action: Sign in as front desk staff and open the same page
user_sees: No "Cancel" and no "Undo cancel" on any membership row

start: Signed in as the owner; member page with a cancelled membership

user_sees: Its unpaid amount is back in Dues as "<amount> due"
must_not: Two undo saves from two fast taps
The plan back with a new first or last day

steps.action: Cancel it again with a new reason
user_sees: The new reason is the one kept
must_not: Both the old and new reason lost

start: Signed in as the owner; member page; a membership cancelled with the reason typed

steps.action: Look where the reason shows, in the panel and in the member's app
user_sees: The reason on the gym's own member page
must_not: The owner's typed reason shown to the member in the app
The reason readable by another gym
